description.en: The name of the DRDS database.
The ID of the DRDS instance.
The end time for executing the flashback SQL.

description.zh:
恢复类型，取值范围如下：
* 1：镜像恢复
* 0：逆向恢复
description.en:
The restore type. Valid values:
* 1: image restore.
* 0: reverse restore.

description.zh:
精确匹配或者模糊匹配，取值范围如下：
* 0：精确匹配
* 1：模糊匹配
description.en:
The match type. Valid values:
* 0: exact match.
* 1: fuzzy match.
The primary key of the flashback SQL.

description.zh: SQL的类型，取值范围为INSERT、UPDATE、DELETE，多种类型间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The type of SQL statement. Valid values: INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE. Separate multiple values with commas (,).
The start time for executing the flashback SQL.
The name of the table on which the flashback SQL operation is performed.
The trace ID of the flashback SQL.
